lede.zh: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 的 TP4 × 2 910B4 服务测试。
lede.en: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 serving measurements on 910B4 with TP4 × 2.

snapshot.zh: 独立实测 · 按负载与采样条件解读
snapshot.en: Independent measurement · interpret with workload and sampling

intro.zh: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 的 TP4 × 2 910B4 服务测试。
intro.en: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 serving measurements on 910B4 with TP4 × 2.

note.zh: 250K 输入的并发点样本量较小；P99 为本轮观测，不代表稳定尾延迟。
note.en: The 250K-input concurrency points use small samples; P99 is a run observation, not a stable tail estimate.

heading.zh: 250K 输入下并发提升先增加吞吐，随后进入延迟拐点
heading.en: Concurrency raises throughput at 250K input, then reaches a latency knee

intro.zh: 固定输入 250,000 tokens、输出 128 tokens；TP4×2，MNB token block 8,192。每个并发档分别执行 2/4/8 个请求。
intro.en: Fixed 250,000-token input and 128-token output; TP4×2 with an 8,192-token MNB block. The three concurrency points ran 2/4/8 requests.

notes.zh: C1→C2 输出吞吐约翻倍；C4 时 TTFT P99 与 TPOT 明显上升，不能把 C4 视为低延迟容量点。
notes.en: Output throughput nearly doubles from C1 to C2; TTFT P99 and TPOT rise sharply at C4, so C4 is not a low-latency capacity point.

notes.zh: 样本量很小，P99 仅作为本轮观测，不足以形成稳定尾延迟承诺。
notes.en: Sample counts are small; P99 is a run observation, not a stable tail-latency guarantee.

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

body.zh: C4 的 P99 TTFT 达到 222.13 s，TPOT 为 521.2 ms；吞吐反而低于 C2。这一档提示排队/资源压力已成为主要因素。
body.en: At C4, TTFT P99 reaches 222.13 s and TPOT is 521.2 ms; throughput is lower than C2, indicating queuing/resource pressure dominates.

intro.zh: 250K 输入工作点记录 KV 池、首 token 和 TPOT。
intro.en: The 250K-input point records KV pool size, time to first token, and TPOT.

hint.zh: 仅显示本配置实测值；缺测点不补零。
hint.en: Measured values for this configuration only; missing points are not filled with zero.

heading.zh: ShareGPT 下并发增长伴随首 token 与解码延迟增加
heading.en: Under ShareGPT, higher concurrency raises first-token and decode latency

intro.zh: ShareGPT 输入约 220、输出约 440 tokens；TP4×2、vLLM-Ascend v0.18.0rc1。每点两次测量，表中为原始两次观测，不做误差外推。
intro.en: ShareGPT prompts average about 220 input and 440 output tokens; TP4×2 on vLLM-Ascend v0.18.0rc1. Each point has two runs; both observations are shown without extrapolating uncertainty.

notes.zh: 并发 64 时输出吞吐达到约 634 tok/s，但 TTFT P99 两次观测分别为 3.16 s 和 3.87 s。
notes.en: At C64, output throughput is about 634 tok/s, while TTFT P99 observations are 3.16 s and 3.87 s.

body.zh: 这是自然长度的 ShareGPT 请求分布，不等同固定输入/输出容量压测；结果依赖数据集长度分布与服务配置。
body.en: This is a natural-length ShareGPT request mix, not a fixed-length capacity benchmark; results depend on prompt lengths and serving configuration.

methodIntro.zh: 不同测试阶段的请求形状、样本量和统计口径单独记录。
methodIntro.en: Workload shape, sample count, and statistics are stated separately by test phase.

methodNotes.zh: 250K 输入的并发点样本量较小；P99 为本轮观测，不代表稳定尾延迟。
methodNotes.en: The 250K-input concurrency points use small samples; P99 is a run observation, not a stable tail estimate.
